scene: A narrow path through a misty pine forest in the early morning, soft shafts of light, the path leading to the centre of the picture.
A shelf of handmade glazed ceramic vases in calm earth tones in front of a sunlit wall, one tall vase in the centre.
A mountain trail winding up a green valley at golden hour, a snowy peak in the centre of the frame.
A small harbour at dawn with a few painted wooden boats on still water, pastel sky, symmetrical composition.
A cosy library alcove with a green reading lamp, an armchair and shelves of books, warm light, centred.
A bright artist studio with a large canvas on an easel in the centre and jars of colourful paint, window light.
A wildflower meadow in evening sun with one lone tree in the centre, long soft shadows.
An old stone bridge over a clear river in a green landscape, the arch reflected in the water, centred.
A market stall with crates of vivid oranges, lemons and peaches in warm morning light, centred.
A glass greenhouse full of tomato plants with sunlight streaming through, a path down the middle.
A white sailboat on calm turquoise water under a clear sky, the boat in the centre.
A lighthouse on a rocky coast at sunset with a glowing orange sky, the tower in the centre.
A mossy waterfall in a green forest with soft mist, the falling water in the centre of the frame.
A rooftop terrace at dusk with string lights, two empty chairs and a small table, city lights in the distance.
A tidy workbench wall of woodworking tools in warm wood tones, a plane and chisels, soft window light, centred.
A still pond with floating water lilies in morning light and a wooden bench at the edge, centred.
Rows of grapevines on a hillside in warm evening light, the rows leading to the centre.
A small telescope on a grassy hill under a deep blue night sky full of stars, centred.
A single cafe table with a cup by a rain-streaked window, warm lamp glow, blurred street lights outside.
A sand dune ridge at sunrise with soft rippled sand and a golden sky, the ridge in the centre.
An autumn beech forest path covered in golden leaves with a soft glow, the path in the centre.
A vintage bicycle leaning against a sunlit brick wall with pots of flowers, centred.
A cosy wooden mountain hut in snow at dusk with one warm glowing window, centred.
A long wooden table set for a meal in an olive grove at golden hour, empty chairs, centred.
A tranquil Japanese-style garden with raked gravel, a red maple and a stone lantern, centred.
An old canal in a historic town at early morning with reflections of gabled houses, symmetrical.
A hot-air balloon floating above a misty valley at sunrise, the balloon in the centre of the frame.
